question: Who is the Chief Minister of Goa as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pramod Sawant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pramod Sawant** is the Chief Minister of Goa as of October 2020.
 
• He succeeded Manohar Parrikar after his demise in March 2019.
 
• Pramod Sawant is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Goa on March 19, 2019.
